message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout that turned our living room into the coziest little hideaway. I grabbed the flashlights and lanterns, and we huddled together with snacks and our favorite board games. It felt like an adventure rather than a hassle! It’s funny how a little darkness can bring a family closer and create some of the best memories. So, next time the lights go out, why not embrace the moment and turn it into a cozy event?
